neutral.EN: Stay with me next time. We watch each other's backs.
neutral.TL: Sumabay ka sa akin sa susunod. Nagbabantayan tayo ng likod.

neutral.EN: Don't leave me behind like that. We survive together.
neutral.TL: Huwag mo akong iiwan nang gano'n. Sabay tayong mabubuhay.

neutral.EN: I almost got swarmed when you ran off. Stick close.
neutral.TL: Halos makuyog ako no'ng umalis ka. Dumikit ka lang.

neutral.EN: We're a team. Don't take off on your own.
neutral.TL: Magkasama tayo. Huwag kang aalis nang mag-isa.

neutral.EN: Where did you go?! You can't just vanish.
neutral.TL: Saan ka pumunta?! Hindi ka pwedeng mawala na lang.

neutral.EN: Next time, warn me before you leave.
neutral.TL: Sa susunod, sabihan mo ako bago ka umalis.

neutral.EN: Thought I was on my own out there. Stay together.
neutral.TL: Akala ko naiwan na akong mag-isa. Magsama tayo.

neutral.EN: Leaving your partner gets people killed. Keep near.
neutral.TL: Ang pag-iwan sa kasama ay nakakamatay. Dumikit ka.

neutral.EN: Glad you're back, but don't ditch me again.
neutral.TL: Mabuti at bumalik ka, pero huwag mo na akong iiwan ulit.

neutral.EN: Stick with me. We're stronger as a pair.
neutral.TL: Sumabay ka sa akin. Mas malakas tayo kapag magkasama.

neutral.EN: I can't find a safe room or campfire nearby.
neutral.TL: Wala akong makitang ligtas na kwarto o campfire sa malapit.

neutral.EN: Nowhere safe to rest around here. We need better cover.
neutral.TL: Walang ligtas na pahingahan dito. Kailangan natin ng mas maayos na silungan.

neutral.EN: Can't camp in the open like this. Too dangerous.
neutral.TL: Hindi pwedeng magkampo sa lantad nang ganito. Masyadong delikado.

neutral.EN: We need walls or a fire before we settle down.
neutral.TL: Kailangan natin ng pader o apoy bago huminto.

neutral.EN: This spot isn't secure enough for camp. Keep walking.
neutral.TL: Hindi sapat ang kaligtasan ng pwestong 'to para sa kampo. Lakad pa.

neutral.EN: No shelter here. Let's find four walls first.
neutral.TL: Walang masisilungan dito. Maghanap muna tayo ng apat na pader.

neutral.EN: Can't sleep here. Infected could walk right in.
neutral.TL: Hindi pwedeng matulog dito. Madaling makakapasok ang mga infected.

neutral.EN: We need a barricaded room or a campfire before resting.
neutral.TL: Kailangan natin ng may barikadang kwarto o campfire bago magpahinga.

neutral.EN: Not pitching camp here. Let's find a secure building.
neutral.TL: Hindi ako magkakampo rito. Maghanap tayo ng ligtas na gusali.

neutral.EN: Too exposed. Find us a real camp spot.
neutral.TL: Masyadong lantad. Hanapan mo tayo ng tunay na matutuluyan.

neutral.EN: I heard you. We will handle it together.
neutral.TL: Narinig kita. Sabay natin 'yang haharapin.

neutral.EN: Understood. I'm right here with you.
neutral.TL: Naintindihan ko. Nandito lang ako kasama mo.

neutral.EN: Got your message. Let's get it done.
neutral.TL: Nakuha ko ang sabi mo. Tapusin na natin.

neutral.EN: I'm with you. Lead the way.
neutral.TL: Kasama mo ako. Ikaw ang manguna.

neutral.EN: Heard. Whatever comes, we take it on.
neutral.TL: Narinig ko. Kahit ano'ng dumating, lalabanan natin.

neutral.EN: Copy that. Staying right by your side.
neutral.TL: Kopya. Dito lang ako sa tabi mo.

neutral.EN: I hear you loud and clear. Let's move.
neutral.TL: Malinaw kong narinig. Kilos na tayo.

neutral.EN: Count on me. We're in this together.
neutral.TL: Maaasahan mo ako. Magkasama tayo rito.

neutral.EN: Understood. Let's keep our heads clear.
neutral.TL: Naiintindihan ko. Panatilihing malinaw ang isip natin.

neutral.EN: Right behind you. Let's handle this.
neutral.TL: Nasa likod mo lang ako. Asikasuhin natin 'to.
